title: Numbers
description: Class 3 IMO — Numbers: 4-digit numbers and place value, expanded and standard form, comparing and ordering, successor/predecessor, skip counting and even/odd numbers.

topics.title: 4-digit Numbers and Place Value
topics.concept:
4-digit numbers are numbers from 1000 to 9999. They have four places: Thousands, Hundreds, Tens and Ones. The smallest 4-digit number is 1000 and the largest is 9999.

Place value is the value of a digit depending on its position. In 3,482 the 3 stands for 3 Thousands (3000), 4 for 4 Hundreds (400), 8 for 8 Tens (80) and 2 for 2 Ones (2). The same digit is worth different amounts in different places.

examples.problem: Write the place value of each digit in 5,673.
What number has 4 Thousands, 0 Hundreds, 9 Tens and 2 Ones?

recap: Place value order: Thousands, Hundreds, Tens, Ones.
The same digit has different values in different places.

quiz.q: What is the place value of the digit 7 in 8,079?
quiz.explanation: In 8,079 the 7 is in the Tens place, so its value is 70.

quiz.q: How many thousands are there in 4,682?
quiz.explanation: The thousands digit in 4,682 is 4, so there are 4 thousands (4000).

topics.title: Expanded Form and Standard Form
topics.concept:
Expanded form shows a number as the sum of the place values of its digits. For example, 3,526 = 3000 + 500 + 20 + 6.

Standard form is the usual way of writing a number with digits. Adding an expanded form gives the standard form: 2000 + 300 + 40 + 5 = 2,345. Being able to switch between the two builds strong number sense.
recap: Expanded form = sum of the place values of the digits.
Standard form = the ordinary number written with digits.
Both forms stand for the same number.

quiz.q: Which is the correct expanded form of 7,042?
quiz.explanation: 7,042 has 7 Thousands, 0 Hundreds, 4 Tens and 2 Ones, so 7000 + 40 + 2.

quiz.q: What is the standard form of 3000 + 20 + 9?

topics.title: Comparing and Ordering Numbers
topics.concept:
We compare numbers using > (greater than), < (less than) and = (equal to). First compare the number of digits — more digits means a larger number. If the digit counts are equal, compare the Thousands place, then Hundreds, then Tens, then Ones.

Ascending order means smallest to largest; descending order means largest to smallest. This helps us rank marks, prices and distances.

examples.solution: Both have 4 thousands. Compare hundreds: 6 > 5, so 4,612 > 4,561.
Thousands and hundreds are equal; compare tens 8, 9, 7. So 3,279 < 3,289 < 3,298.

recap: Compare digits from the left (Thousands first).

quiz.explanation: Thousands and hundreds are equal; tens 3 > 1, so 5,231 > 5,213.

quiz.q: Riya has ₹2,450 and Sameer has ₹2,540. Who has more money?
quiz.explanation: Thousands are equal; hundreds 5 > 4, so ₹2,540 > ₹2,450 — Sameer has more.

topics.title: Successor, Predecessor and Skip Counting
topics.concept:
The successor of a number is 1 more than it — the successor of 2,599 is 2,600. The predecessor is 1 less — the predecessor of 5,000 is 4,999.

Skip counting means counting by a fixed jump such as 2, 3, 4, 5 or 10. For example, skip counting by 3 gives 3, 6, 9, 12. It builds multiplication skills.

examples.problem: Find the successor of 3,499 and the predecessor of 7,000.
Write the next 3 numbers in skip counting by 4 starting from 12.

recap: Skip counting jumps by the same amount each time.

quiz.q: A bus stops at every 5th house. If its first stop is house number 10, which house is the second stop?
quiz.explanation: Skip counting by 5 from 10: 10, 15, … so the second stop is 15.

topics.title: Even, Odd Numbers and Forming Numbers
topics.concept:
Even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8 and can be split into two equal groups. Odd numbers end in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9 and leave a remainder of 1 when divided by 2.

To form the smallest number from given digits, arrange them in ascending order, but never put 0 first. For the largest number, arrange them in descending order. For digits 3, 0, 8, 1: largest = 8,310 and smallest = 1,038 (0 cannot be first).

examples.solution: 4,560 ends in 0, so it is even. 2,347 and 3,821 end in 7 and 1, so they are odd.

examples.problem: Using digits 5, 2, 9, 0 once each, form the smallest 4-digit number.
examples.solution: Ascending digits are 0, 2, 5, 9; since 0 cannot be first, the smallest is 2,059.

recap: Smallest number: smallest digit first (but not 0).

quiz.q: How many even numbers are in this list:  1,234 ; 1,235 ; 1,236 ; 1,237 ?
quiz.explanation: 1,234 ends in 4 and 1,236 ends in 6 — both even. The others are odd, so there are 2 even numbers.

quiz.q: What is the largest 4-digit number using the digits 2, 7, 0, 5 without repeating?
quiz.explanation: Arrange the digits in descending order: 7, 5, 2, 0 → 7,520.

questions.q: The place value of 6 in 6,342 is ______.
questions.explanation: 6 is in the Thousands place, so its place value is 6 × 1000 = 6,000.

questions.q: Which number has 4 Thousands, 3 Hundreds, 0 Tens and 8 Ones?
What is the successor of 1,999?
Arrange in ascending order: 3,210 ; 3,201 ; 3,120.
Which is the correct expanded form of 9,005?
Skip counting by 3 starting from 6, what is the 4th number?
Rohan bought a toy for ₹2,345 and a book for ₹1,230. Which comparison is correct?
questions.explanation: 2,345 has 2 thousands while 1,230 has 1 thousand, so ₹2,345 > ₹1,230.

questions.q: What is the predecessor of 3,500?
Using digits 4, 1, 0, 7 once each, what is the smallest 4-digit number?
questions.explanation: Ascending digits are 0, 1, 4, 7; 0 cannot be first, so the smallest is 1,047.

questions.q: Which of these numbers is an odd number?
questions.explanation: An odd number ends in 1, 3, 5, 7 or 9. Only 5,281 ends in 1, so it is odd.

questions.q: A school has 2,345 boys and 2,354 girls. Which statement is true?
questions.explanation: Thousands and hundreds are equal; tens 4 < 5, so 2,345 < 2,354 — boys < girls.

questions.q: Which of the following is an even number?
questions.explanation: Even numbers end in 0, 2, 4, 6 or 8. 3,232 ends in 2, so it is even.

questions.q: What is the largest number formed by the digits 8, 0, 3, 5?
Neha has ₹4,500 and her sister has ₹4,050. How much more does Neha have?
Which of these is correct?
questions.explanation: Thousands and hundreds are equal; tens 5 < 6, so 3,456 < 3,465.

questions.q: What is the missing number in skip counting by 4:  12, ___, 20, 24 ?
questions.explanation: 12 + 4 = 16 and 16 + 4 = 20, so the missing number is 16.

questions.q: A bus has seats numbered 1 to 50. Which of these seat numbers is odd and lies in the forties (4 in the Tens place)?
questions.explanation: All are in the forties, but only 45 ends in an odd digit, so 45 is the odd one.

questions.q: How many 4-digit numbers can be formed using the digits 2 and 3 only (repetition allowed)?
questions.explanation: Each of the 4 places can be 2 or 3: 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 16 numbers.

questions.q: The predecessor of the smallest 4-digit number is ______.
questions.explanation: The smallest 4-digit number is 1,000, and its predecessor is 999.

questions.q: Using digits 9, 2, 0, 1 once each, what is the difference between the largest and smallest 4-digit numbers?
questions.explanation: Largest = 9,210 and smallest = 1,029 (0 cannot be first), so 9,210 − 1,029 = 8,181.
